title: Docs: Hosted canary rollouts (GA) — create flow, guardrails, monitoring, rollback + migration notes
author: Wei Chen
description: This PR updates the docs site for Hosted canary rollouts GA. It consolidates the beta-era notes into a GA-ready guide focused on the Console workflow and the underlying routing/guardrail semantics. It also adds monitoring guidance (what to watch + how to interpret baseline vs candidate deltas) and a clear pause/rollback playbook. Scope: (1) New end-to-end guide: create a canary rollout on a Hosted route (baseline vs candidate), choose traffic split strategy, set a manual or timed schedule, configure guardrails, and launch. (2) Guardrails reference: latency/error/cost guardrails with recommended defaults and how enforcement works (pause vs automatic rollback). (3) Monitoring: variant compare dashboards, metrics naming/labels, and alerting tips (including cardinality cautions for route IDs). (4) Rollback/pause: step-by-step instructions (pause, set candidate to 0%, rollback) and what happens for streaming requests / retries. (5) Migration notes: what changes from beta, feature availability/entitlements callouts, and where to find audit trail / audit log export info. Not in scope: A/B experimentation semantics, offline eval configuration details, or Private/Dedicated rollout workflows. Screenshots: placeholders are included; final screenshots will be swapped in after the last UI copy pass (tracked in ENG-8427).
release_notes: Docs published with GA: new Hosted canary rollouts guide, guardrails reference, monitoring + rollback troubleshooting, and beta-to-GA migration notes.
commits: docs(hosted-rollouts): add GA canary rollout guide and glossary
docs(guardrails): document error/latency/cost thresholds + recommended defaults
docs(monitoring): add baseline vs candidate compare section + metrics/labels
docs(rollback): add pause/rollback steps and streaming retry semantics note
docs(migration): add beta-to-GA FAQ and permissions/entitlements callouts
chore(ci): fix link-check exclusions and update nav entries
